verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no Jira-native capability for creating and organizing shared docs or notes. Docs appear only through Confluence, a separate Atlassian product that customers add to Jira. That integration is an adjacent capability and earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create and organize shared docs and notes alongside my project work

citations.quote: 76% of Jira Software customers said they shipped projects faster after adding Confluence to help organize and manage agile projects.
